_about: Rotation/scale pivots [x, y] in the 160x160 viewBox, neutral pose. Nested groups (arm > claw > jaw, eye > lid) use the same numbers: SVG applies the child's rotate() in the parent's pre-transform frame, so these coordinates hold for rotate(a x y) at every depth. Positive rotation is clockwise.

_notes.squash: scale(1/sqrt(s), s) about pinch-root, so volume is kept
_notes.pinch: close: jaw-*-bottom rotates toward the top jaw (l: -18deg, r: +18deg) while jaw-*-top gives 35% of that the other way; open is the reverse
_notes.eyes: blink = scaleY(eyeOpen) on the eye ellipse about the eye pivot; lid-* is a body-coloured cap whose lower edge drops for squints (path in pose files)
_notes.lens: authored centred on (0,0), handle along +y; place it with translate(x y) rotate(a). Hidden (opacity 0) in the idle file, parked at the right claw. _grip-r is where the right claw holds a handle
_notes.outline: --pinch-outline: #365900 on light grounds, #8FD400 rim or transparent on dark grounds
